annotations.title: Fetch the NIN slip for a registration

description: Get their NIN slip for them from NIMC's record for their confirmed NIN, instead of them uploading a photo of it, once their NIN is confirmed. Free to them. Never replaces a slip they already have unless replace=true (they asked). The slip is never shown to them.
name: fetch_nin_slip
